title: What the shutter template can confirm
titleZh: 窗板樣板能確認哪些事項
passage: The replacement shutters arrived this morning. You can check their size without lifting a panel out of its box. There’s a card template in each box. Hold the edge of the template against the frame to see whether it covers the opening. That only checks the outline. The holes marked on the card are for the clips used during shipping, not for the mounting brackets. If the outline fits, write “size checked” on the box and leave the clips in place. I’ll check the mounting points when I get there. If the outline doesn’t fit, send me a photo with the template still against the frame. I need to see where it falls short.
passageZh: 替換用的防風窗板今早送到了。核對尺寸時，不用把窗板從箱子抬出來。每箱都有一張紙卡樣板。把樣板邊緣貼著窗框，確認它能不能蓋住開口。 這樣只核對外形。紙卡上標的孔是運送用夾具的位置，不是安裝支架的孔位。如果外形吻合，就在箱上寫「尺寸已核對」，先別拆夾具。我到場後會檢查安裝位置。 如果外形不合，請讓樣板保持貼在窗框上，再拍照傳給我。我要看它哪裡蓋不到。
